content.title: Karol G delays her Coachella set and this is the official schedule | LatiNation
content.text: Karol G delays her official performance on the Coachella main stage to 10:10 p.m. this Sunday, April 19. The festival organization in The United States adjusted the schedule to optimize logistics after the technical delays of the first weekend. Fans can follow La Bichota’s show completely live through Coachella’s official YouTube channel. Expectations for the second weekend in the desert are reaching their peak, yet the Colombian artist’s followers must keep an eye on the clock; specifically, Karol G delays her Coachella set until 10:10 p.m. (Pacific Time), which represents a 15-minute adjustment from her previous slot. Selena's Legacy Lives on at the Grammy Museum0 seconds of 3 minutes, 12 secondsVolume 0% This decision regarding the new schedule comes after last Sunday’s main stage logistics caused a late start, leaving thousands of fans in The United States waiting for nearly half an hour; likewise, organizers aim for this second round to be flawless to close the event on a high note; consequently, this small schedule change allows for better technical preparation for the Bichota’s visual display; in fact, the global YouTube broadcast will also adapt to this new time block. Logistics and the impact of the first Latina headliner Making history requires perfection and the festival production team is polishing every detail to avoid the debut’s setbacks; therefore, Karol G’s new schedule at Coachella responds to the need to ensure that the technical setup remains ready before her grand entrance. The first weekend was a celebration of Latino pride where the artist wore her flag’s colors and thrilled all of The United States with her biggest hits; likewise, the integration of cultural elements and visual surprises demands a milimetric coordination that justifies this slight programmed delay; in this sense, time management on the world’s largest stages remains key to the success of a star of her caliber; for this reason, the community stands ready to connect and experience the party. Hype intact and festival closure in The United States Despite the adjustments in the new schedule, follower enthusiasm does not drop a single gram for the closure of the 2026 edition; furthermore, Karol G prepares to consolidate her legacy at Coachella with a show that promises to exceed the energy of her first night. This Sunday, April 19, will be the final opportunity to see the Colombian’s power display at the Empire Polo Club before the festival curtains close; according to social media rumors, the Bichota might have new surprises prepared for this second round; indeed, the schedule adjustment ensures that the fan experience remains fluid and charged with pure adrenaline; so set the reminder on your phone because on Sunday night the world turns pink again. Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G led the aesthetic narrative, blending classic Hollywood references with elevated Latin empowerment. The “barrel shorts” trend and sustainable materials emerged as the standout fashion pillars among headliners and influencers alike. Indio, California, once again became the global epicenter of trends. The first weekend of Coachella 2026 did not disappoint. Delivering a vibrant mix of nostalgia, relaxed luxury, and a visual audacity that redefines festival fashion. From the main stages to exclusive record label parties, celebrities utilized the desert as their private runway, proving that at the Empire Polo Club, what you wear is just as important as what you hear. Selena's Legacy Lives on at the Grammy Museum0 seconds of 3 minutes, 12 secondsVolume 0% The era of “Sabrinawood” and pop-doll style Sabrina Carpenter was undoubtedly one of Friday’s major protagonists. Following a cinematic debut that paid tribute to classic Hollywood, the singer opted for a pop-star look that fused sweetness with provocation. She wore a shimmering top and a pleated skirt that screamed youthful sophistication. However, the most talked-about moment featured her T-shirt with the message “Jesus Was a Carpenter,”. A choice that confirmed irony as the coolest accessory of 2026. Her constant outfit changes throughout the set provided a masterclass on how to adapt high fashion to the desert’s energy. Karol G: Latin style in the desert Sunday marked a historic milestone with the performance of Karol G, the first Latina woman to headline Coachella. Her presence on stage was an explosion of color and empowerment. Dressed in pieces that accentuated her figure while maintaining the “Bichota” style in its most elevated version, the Colombian star proved her reign is as much aesthetic as it is musical. The attention to detail, from her hair to her footwear, matched a performance already being described as legendary. The Justin factor and the influencer army On Saturday, the main stage welcomed a Justin Bieber who bet on comfort without losing his trendy edge. The Canadian star wore barrel shorts, one of the strongest trends of 2026, reaffirming his status as an icon of slouchy streetwear. Accompanying him, Hailey Bieber once again became the focus of photographers with a look destined to be copied by thousands in the coming weeks. The venue was also conquered by social media “royalty.” Charli and Dixie D’Amelio, along with figures like Addison Rae and Maddie Ziegler, showcased proposals ranging from vintage to futuristic. The Spanish presence was also felt with influencers such as Aitana Soriano, who brought European style to the heart of the Coachella Valley. Details you can’t miss Beyond the headliners, the festival offered exquisite fashion moments on secondary stages. PinkPantheress brought her British year 2000 aesthetic, while the global group KATSEYE dazzled with coordinated yet individualistic ensembles in their festival debut. Fringes, desert boots, sheers and the ever-reliable cropped denim remain pillars for attendees, but this year features a shift toward sustainable materials and experimental silhouettes. Coachella 2026 makes it clear that fashion is no longer just about following a trend, but about creating a moment worth sharing on the feed. Lola Índigo also shines on the winners’ list by receiving the Evolution Award, highlighting her capacity for constant transformation within the industry. The Billboard gala will also recognize the legacy of legendary figures such as Gloria Trevi and Julieta Venegas alongside the new force of Young Miko. The news that Rosalía will receive the most prestigious award of the night confirms that her artistic vision continues to set the pace for global pop culture; specifically, the Billboard Latin Women in Music organization highlighted her ability to create trends instead of following them, especially after the release of her fourth studio album. Selena's Legacy Lives on at the Grammy Museum0 seconds of 3 minutes, 12 secondsVolume 0% Although the Spanish star currently finds herself in the middle of her LUX Tour across Europe, her presence at the ceremony, which Telemundo and Peacock will broadcast, remains one of the most anticipated moments for fans in The United States and the world; likewise, the recognition celebrates a career that knows how to blend tradition with the avant-garde; consequently, this award solidifies her as the most influential female figure in music today. Double Spanish victory on the international stage European and Latino pride doubles with the inclusion of Lola Índigo, who earned the Evolution Award thanks to a career that never stops mutating and surprising; for example, the Granada native has transitioned from being “the girl” to becoming “the dragon,” achieving resounding success with each new artistic stage. This distinction for Rosalía and Lola puts the spotlight on how talent coming from Spain and music in Spanish manages to connect deeply with the audience in The United States and other corners of the world, creating an indestructible cultural bridge; therefore, seeing two artists of the same nationality sharing the Billboard podium represents a historic milestone for the industry; furthermore, the impact of Lola Índigo with her recent track “Tus Iniciales” reinforces her position as an artist who dominates both the dance floor and the playlists. A night of legends and unstoppable stars The ceremony not only looks toward the future but also pays tribute to the careers that paved the way for new generations of artists; for this reason, the presentation of the Lifetime Achievement Award to Gloria Trevi and the recognition of Julieta Venegas for Artistic Excellence complete a night charged with emotion. The inclusion of Young Miko as an “unstoppable artist” proves that Billboard remains attentive to the new phenomena that are redefining the urban genre in The United States; in fact, the event serves as the primary benchmark for celebrating the female impact on Latin music; finally, this Thursday’s gala will be a display that makes it clear that Rosalía and her colleagues are the women who run the music business and that they are truly unstoppable. Produced by Cardenas Marketing Network (CMN), this tour promises not just a musical spectacle, but a celebration of more than four decades of an unparalleled career that has left its mark on entire generations. This tour is the opportunity to experience in person the passion, charisma and inexhaustible energy that only the Puerto Rican artist can deliver on stage.
